headline: Mr Overs Retakes The Throne, Roscoe Loses 34 Points In A Week, And Sammy Is Digging A Hole
intro: Leon is back on top at 31.9, just 0.7 clear of Visdog, while last week's king Roscoe got absolutely hosed for a 34-point drop and slid to third. It's only 11 to 14 games in, so projections are swinging like a screen door in a cyclone, but the bottom three (Sammy, Harry and Pos) are already well into the dregs. Remember: in this comp a single −10 will kill ya, and whoever finishes last is eating Roscoe's shit.

players.name: Leon
players.text: Back on top at 31.9 (+7.3), and Mr Overs shows optimism has merit. Rockets (63 wins pace), Blazers and Grizzlies are carrying the load while the Jazz at 1–12 sit there at −31.2 like a boat anchor. Efficiency says 44.8, so he's actually travelling better than the scoreboard shows. Steven Adams is back for the Rockets, but at 8 minutes a game that's not moving anything.

players.name: Nic
players.text: Visdog's 0.7 off top spot, but he dropped 7.6 this week and the Thunder are the culprit: that Over 62.5 shed 15.1 and is now −12. The Blazers Under (−19) is also cooked at 9–3, and the Kings and Bucks Unders at 1–11 and 1–12 are keeping the wheels on. Efficiency has him at just 7.2, so that rank of 2 is a bit of a flatterer. Nikola Topic's back for OKC, which technically helps the Over, but at a −3 wins-at-stake impact it's more of a prayer.

players.name: Roscoe the Dog
players.text: From bossing the comp to a 34.2-point face-plant: the Heat Under bled 16.8 (Giannis dropping 34 in a 137–117 flogging of the Pistons will do that), the Pelicans Over lost 13 with the Pels on a 6-game skid, and the Hawks Over gave back 8. Still 18.5 and third, so the dog's bark remains worse than his bite. Klay Thompson was out and back for Miami in a day, so keep an eye on that Heat Under.

players.name: Angus
players.text: Gooey climbed 14.1 to 17.7, mostly off the Pelicans Under (+13, and Denver just handed NOLA a sixth straight loss), and the Lakers Over at 11–2 is a beauty. The Raptors Over at 5–7 (−11.4) is the problem child, and the Warriors Under at 8–5 is quietly costing him. Jalen Johnson's return helps the Hawks, but that's Roscoe's pick, not Gooey's. Pelicans without Murray and Trey Murphy III is a gift for his Under, though Yves Missi's back.

players.name: Ned
players.text: Down 2 to 11.0, and the Rockets Under at 10–3 (−15.6) is the open wound. The Thunder Under at least did something useful (+15.1), and Magic Under dropped 15.9 with Jalen Suggs back in the lineup. Efficiency says 8.3, so he's drifting along about where he should be: a very average Ned. If the Thunder keep slumping with Ajay Mitchell now out, that Under gets healthier.

players.name: Dan
players.text: Doccy sheds 9.6 to land at 3.2, and the Clippers Under (3–8, down 12.1) bled out despite the team being rubbish. Spurs Over and 76ers Over are both flying, but the Lakers Under at 11–2 is a −22.9 slab of concrete round his neck. And with De'Aaron Fox going down for San Antonio, that Spurs Over might need some nervous chewing of fingernails. Efficiency has him at −5.2, so he's skating on thin ice.

players.name: Marco
players.text: Marci's up 12.0 but still in the red at −8.1. The Wizards Under (+9.3) and Wolves Over are doing the job, but the Hornets Over is a −12.2 mess (−22.5 on efficiency) and the Cavs Over at 7–7 is going nowhere. Evan Mobley went out for Cleveland this week, though the Cavs beat Dallas without their entire starting five, so credit where it's due. Cheers to Grant Williams being back, but it's a small fix for the Hornets.

players.name: Pos
players.text: A 19.4-point recovery, the biggest of anyone, and he's still −23.7. The Jazz Under is a whopping +31.2, but the Grizzlies Under at 9–4 is a −27.3 disaster, and Memphis just beat Brooklyn by 19. Kings Over at 1–11 and Spurs Under at 11–2 are both rotting. Efficiency has him at −33.9, so the pain isn't over. Jalen Johnson back for Atlanta nudges the Hawks up, which doesn't help his Under.

players.name: Sam
players.text: Sammy's 38.6 under and falling (−14.4 this week), and the 76ers Under at 11–3 is −13.9 of pain, with LeBron apparently now in Philly passing Kidd on the assists list. The Bucks Over at 1–12 is −19.2 and the Pacers Over at 5–9 is another −15.2. Here's a silver lining, though: efficiency has him at +12.2, so the points say his picks are cleaner than the wins. Joel Embiid sitting out Sunday with plantar fascia management is bad news for his Under, which needs Philly to stumble.

players.name: Harry
players.text: Harry holds the spoon at −42.1, so consider this your gentle reminder about Roscoe's shit. Efficiency is a ghastly −47.8, so there's no hiding. Wins pace has him up 15.0 this week thanks to the Magic Over (+15.9) and the Clippers Over bouncing back, but the Celtics Under at 10–2 (−16.8) is the sort of pick that haunts a man. Devin Carter's return only makes Boston's life easier, so the Celtics Under is still pointing the wrong way.

signoff: May your unders tank and your overs thrive!
